content:
I was trained on a diverse range of text data from books, articles, websites, and other written materials up until 2023. My training data includes a wide variety of topics, allowing me to generate human-like text and provide information on many subjects. However, I don’t have personal experiences, emotions, or consciousness—my responses are generated based on patterns in the data I was trained on.

For specific details about the datasets or training process, Mistral AI (my creator) has documented some of that in their [model card](https://mistral.ai/news/announcing-mistral-7b/).
